subject.title: chore(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 12 updates

question: After the stale guard assertions and Codex contract check are resolved, should these twelve privileged GitHub Action upgrades be accepted as one security-reviewed bundle?
rationale: The revisions execute with secrets, publishing, agent, and scanning permissions, so final supply-chain trust acceptance requires the workflow and security owners rather than automated judgment.

options.title: Review and land the bundle
options.body: Repair the guards, inspect each upstream revision and Codex contract, and merge only after exact-head checks and security-owner approval.

options.title: Split privileged upgrades
options.body: Separate token, publishing, CodeQL, and Codex changes from lower-risk setup actions to reduce each trust review boundary.

options.title: Pause the update
options.body: Defer the bundle if direct source review cannot establish acceptable behavior for every privileged revision.

recommendation.title: Review and land the bundle
recommendation.body: Repair the guards, inspect each upstream revision and Codex contract, and merge only after exact-head checks and security-owner approval.

likelyOwner.reason: CODEOWNERS explicitly assigns the most security-sensitive changed workflows and tests to this team.
